timecoded_text_to_speech.text: My name is Diana and I am a digital storyteller from Lavaoui.
I am Phara Abdi, originally from Somalia, grew up in Kenya.
My name is Deepa and I am from India.
Hello, my name is Himalaya Pashia.
I am 22 years old and I have a role.
My name is Jessalina Rana.
I am a human rights lawyer.
Hi, my name is Jo.
I am from South India.
I am Rinalini.
I am a researcher and designer from India.
My name is Salman Swahiji.
I am from Sarawabasana, Tugana.
I am a farm, adventurous and creative.
I am a very passionate and passionate dreamer.
I am very very optimistic and I like interior design.
I am an extremely confused person.
I am very very curious and I am an animal wood.
I am a feminist, a philosopher and an artist.
I dedicated ambitious and curious.
I am passionate, I am feminist and I am a little prone to procrastination.
I am pathetic, perseverant and someone who believes a good balance is the key to a great life.
Spontaneous, impulsive are these words probably mean the same thing but that's probably what I think of myself and dreaming.
I am very enthusiastic.
I love tech, technology projects and I am definitely a planner for surveillance, action and resilience.
I run an Instagram page called the Nepali feminist and have been doing so since 2017,
focusing on intersection of feminist advocacy in Nepal.
So my project idea for the global feminist page had a lot to do with telling the stories of trans women of color.
I have a really good project idea, my partner Deepa and I.
We host a weekly conversation podcast called Forset Feminism.
Forset in Urdu essentially translates to leisure.

My project for the global feminist page is called To the streets and it is a visual story telling project that is centered around telling stories and showcasing the work that Malawi and feminists are doing.
My global feminist page project idea is called Kachon which is also the name of my social media pages.
Jo and I are the co-producers of Transform which was conceptualized by Jo based on their experiences.
My GFP project idea is called Ponsionatives. It is a local youth-led initiative using leisure, advocacy and storytelling.
The global feminist page idea is a both-guess called Feminism's self-sook or Feminism's self-to-self in English.
The global feminist page changed my life because I was able to be myself.
In part of the global feminist page has been so impactful for my life because one, it allowed me to connect with people who are like-minded and drink such incredible work.
Prior to the project I wasn't well connected to all the advocacy efforts that were being undertaken.
By knowing that somebody believes in us, it sort of does change your life.
The call I was like, oh my god, this resonates so well with what I have in my head.
When GFP picked us up, an NREQ World Foundation decided to support us for this project, it was a huge relief.
It provided me with a space for feminist action and it allowed me to use my knowledge and my art, the ways that I believe useful for society.
So many dreams, so many projects, so many things that I need to bring to reality.
My future is now always be associated with feminist movement building spaces.
In the future I want to be able to take my learnings back to Nepal.
I want to be able to tell stories of marginalized people.
To be able to be a feminist without having to project a usage.
I see myself being as a positive as I am right now creating more projects.
I would like to continue working on my pages.
I think everyone who doesn't accept patriarchy as the own narrative for society should apply for the global feminist pitch.
If you have something that you think doing it, executing it could change the world and impact the world.
It would do good in the world. I would encourage you to give the global feminist pitch a chance.
Simply because you are going to find people who actually listen to you.

If you are someone who believes in a feminist issue, believes that your cause needs to be heard and believes that you need a platform to take forward this cause, I would urge you to apply to the global feminist pitch.

youtube_description:
Meet our selected feminists for the Global Feminist Pitch 2021 as they talk about their project ideas and how the Global Feminist Pitch has helped to implement them.


More information on the Global Feminist Pitch: https://www.boell.de/en/2021/04/13/global-feminist-pitch-Feminist-resilience-and-resistance-on-social-media
